name: zhang-qian-western-mission
description: A Han envoy set out across the steppe to seek allies against the nomads and was held captive for years.

name: cleopatra-meets-antony-tarsus
description: The Egyptian queen sailed up the river in a gilded barge to meet the Roman general and win him as an ally.

name: roman-embassy-han-court
friendly_name: Roman Envoys Reach the Han Court
description: Travellers claiming to represent a Roman emperor reached the Chinese capital by sea and presented ivory and horn.

name: abul-abbas-elephant-charlemagne
description: The caliph's gift of an elephant named Abul-Abbas arrived at the Frankish emperor's court after a long journey.

name: ibn-fadlan-volga-embassy
friendly_name: Ibn Fadlan's Embassy to the Volga
description: A caliph's envoy travelled north to the king of the Volga Bulgars and left a vivid account of the Norse traders he met.

name: carpini-mission-great-khan
description: A Franciscan friar sent by the pope crossed Asia to attend a Mongol ruler's enthronement and deliver a letter.

name: rabban-sauma-embassy-europe
description: A Chinese-born Nestorian monk sent by the Mongol Il-Khan met kings and the pope seeking an alliance against Muslim rivals.

name: clavijo-embassy-timur
description: A Castilian envoy was received in a pavilion at Samarkand by the conqueror and wrote a famous account of the journey.

name: matteo-ricci-enters-beijing
description: A Jesuit scholar with clocks and maps gained entry to the Forbidden City and an audience at the Ming court.

name: hasekura-embassy-rome
description: A samurai sent by a Japanese lord crossed the Pacific and Atlantic to meet the pope and the king of Spain.

name: siamese-embassy-louis-xiv
description: Envoys of the king of Siam arrived at Versailles in splendid costume, dazzling the French court.

name: peter-great-grand-embassy
description: The young Russian tsar toured Western Europe incognito, working in shipyards and meeting kings to modernise his country.

name: iwakura-mission-west
description: A large delegation of Japanese leaders visited America and Europe to study modern states and seek treaty revision.

name: bjorko-meeting-kaiser-tsar
friendly_name: Kaiser and Tsar Meet at Bjorko
description: Two emperors met on a yacht in the Baltic and secretly signed a defensive pact that their ministers soon rejected.

name: vienna-summit-kennedy-khrushchev
description: The young American president and the Soviet premier held a tense two-day summit that left Kennedy shaken.

name: sadat-visits-jerusalem
description: The Egyptian president flew to Israel and addressed its parliament, the first Arab leader to make such a visit.

name: reykjavik-summit-reagan-gorbachev
description: The American and Soviet leaders met in an Icelandic house and nearly agreed to abolish all nuclear weapons.
